DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder).

The clinical picture of a 55-year-old woman with insidious onset of chronic shoulder pain, significant restriction in both active and passive range of motion, and sleep disturbance, strongly points to adhesive capsulitis. Her diabetes is a significant risk factor for this condition. Given the classic presentation, no further diagnostic tests are required.
